cohort: 892 women with dichorionic diamniotic twin pregnancies who delivered at a teaching hospital in London, UK, between 2000 and 2010
finding: Vaginal delivery in dichorionic diamniotic twins had a good success rate (46.4% spontaneous vaginal delivery) and a low intrapartum emergency cesarean delivery rate (34.8%).
mod_finding: Vaginal delivery in dichorionic diamniotic twins had a good success rate and a low intrapartum emergency cesarean delivery rate.
